title: Quantization profiles: mixed‑precision throughput vs quality contour benchmarking
creator: Priya Natarajan
description:
Goal: Build a benchmark and load harness that maps throughput (tokens/sec) and p95 latency to quality for a range of quantization profiles (FP16, INT8, INT4, and mixed-precision fallbacks). This ticket covers spec, harness implementation, quality metric plumbing, regression detection rules, and dashboards to visualize quality/perf contours and automated alerts when a quant profile crosses a regression threshold.

Scope and constraints:
- Run mixed-precision permutations where compute kernels use FP16 for attention and INT8/INT4 for MLP where supported. Include explicit fallback variants (e.g., INT4->INT8->FP16) and measure cost/latency tradeoffs.
- Collect tokens/sec, p50/p95/p99 latency, memory footprint, kernel utilization, and end-to-end quality metrics (token-level perplexity proxy + embedding cosine similarity and ROUGE on a canonical prompt set).
- Support traffic modes: synthetic steady-state, production-trace replay (sampled requests), and bursty arrival patterns.
- Include KV-cache warmup experiments and cold-cache baselines.
- Provide an automated regression detector using EWMA+CUSUM for latency and a separate quality drift detector (paired permutation t-test on similarity distributions), with configurable SLOs.
- Output consumable artifacts: CSV/Parquet run exports, a contour heatmap generator, and Grafana dashboards with example alerts.

Non-goals:
- Model re-training or calibration. Policy or rollout automation beyond reporting.
acceptance_criteria:
1) Harness can run all profile permutations (FP16, INT8, INT4, and 2 mixed-precision variants) across three traffic modes and export unified results.
2) For each run we record tokens/sec, p50/p95/p99, memory, kernel utilization, embedding similarity, and ROUGE scores; artifacts export as CSV and Parquet.
3) Contour heatmaps generated that visualize quality (embedding similarity) vs throughput for each profile and prompt bucket.
4) Regression detector flags both latency and quality regressions with a reproducible test case; alerts surface in staging Grafana.
5) Documentation + runbook for interpreting contours and recommended fallback thresholds is added to Confluence.
6) End-to-end benchmarking run completed on dedicated infra (small scale) and results reviewed by PM and SRE.
comments: 2026-02-18 Priya Natarajan: Created ticket. Initial spec in Confluence (link attached). Goals are to de-risk INT4 rollouts by making quality/perf tradeoffs explicit and actionable.

2026-02-22 Liam O'Connor: Spike complete — implemented a prototype harness using locust-like driver + replay engine. Observations: INT4 gives 1.9x tokens/sec improvement on small models but similarity drop varies by prompt bucket. Need canonical prompt buckets and stable similarity metric.
2026-02-25 SRE review (Daniel Cho): Suggested we add kernel-level GPU counters and account for NVLINK traffic for multi-GPU configs. Also asked for cold-cache runs for KV cache analysis.

2026-02-27 Priya Natarajan: Added planned detection rules: EWMA for p95 latency (alpha=0.2, window=5m) + CUSUM to catch sudden shifts. For quality, propose bootstrapped confidence interval on mean cosine sim; flag if drop > 0.015 and p-value < 0.01. Open to tuning.

2026-03-01 Liam O'Connor: Implemented export pipeline (CSV + Parquet). Hooked up precomputed embedding evaluation for similarity. Generated first contour heatmaps for three models; pushing draft dashboards to staging Grafana (link attached).

2026-03-03 PM feedback (Eva Gomez): For product decisions we need a 'cost per useful token' column (est token cost using model spec + perf). Also request CSV of recommended rollback thresholds per profile. Adding as acceptance criteria item.

2026-03-05 Liam O'Connor: Updated harness to compute estimated cost/token using current price book. Regression detector now emits JSON alerts to staging Alertmanager mock. Next: schedule a review with PM and SRE and run a small-scale sweep across representative customers' prompt buckets.
2026-03-05 Priya Natarajan: Moving status to In Progress. Blocking: access to a large multi-GPU testbed for the final sweep (ticketed with infra).
notes:
Implementation plan: 1) Finalize canonical prompt buckets (conversational, instruction, long-context) and evaluation metrics. 2) Implement harness runner + replay driver + metrics exporters. 3) Integrate kernel and GPU counters. 4) Run baseline FP16, then INT8/INT4 permutations, collect artifacts. 5) Generate contours, tune detectors, review with stakeholders. 6) Add runbook and rollout guidance.

Telemetry output formats: CSV rows with run_id, profile, prompt_bucket, tokens_sec, p50_ms, p95_ms, p99_ms, mem_gb, kernel_util_pct, emb_sim_mean, emb_sim_std, rouge_f1, est_cost_per_1000_tokens. Parquet mirror for downstream analysis.

Run plan for first sweep: small-model (7B) single-GPU, medium-model (13B) single-GPU, large-model (70B) multi-GPU with KV-cache warm/cold. Each model: 3 traffic modes x 3 seeds. Expected run time ~8h per model.
notes_for_reviewers: Please validate the proposed quality thresholds and the statistical test choices. PM requested cost-per-use column; SRE requested additional noise injection tests. If you have a preference for similarity metric (cosine vs. BLEU vs. ROUGE), call it out now.
